entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A human scoundrel captain of the Seriema who rescues irradiated Kav soldiers and investigates why the stolen stone seems tied to the empty mine at Sigma's Reach.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate and former Kavaron Memorial Navy command pilot, exiled as a murderer for choosing which Kav would die in a bolide strike; he poses as a stroke-addled man named Gorodoro.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist whose crashed Hopelight irradiated the Kav team; he lies comatose in a locked cabin after touching the stone, with a hole in his right palm.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, which carries the stolen stone in a hotcell and lands at Taro-duend.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: A temporary salvage and mining settlement on Kavaron That Is, run by a coach and a political postilion.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: A broken planet, with Kavaron That Is the ruined half where Taro-duend stands and Kavaron Before the habitable half.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav navy whose twenty-four irradiated soldiers Sami ferries to safety.

entities.name: Guns of Kavaron
entities.description: Kavaron's orbital defensive lasers, which Tannuk once commanded to brake a bolide.

entities.name: Summotank
entities.description: A Kav city of four million on a drainage lake, saved when Tannuk braked a bolide.

entities.name: Rushdown range
entities.description: Mountain villages with under thirty thousand people that were struck by the bolide Tannuk braked.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: A place where Sami and Tannuk found the stone; no mine there ever opened, yet moxite from it is supposed to have undercut Kav prices.

entities.name: The Metalman's artifact
entities.description: A stolen stone held in stasis in the Seriema's hotcell; touching it made Alpharael fall into a fit.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: The patron to whom Sami intends to give the stone.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Someone whose picture Sami carries and asks the postilion about.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: A ship from Sami's past whose captain had to triage a disaster.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar fighting order, whose ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The authority to which Sami says the Seriema's flight plan is on file.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: The Pinnacle contact point listed in Seriema's flight plan.

events.summary: Sami broadcasts a mayday to Taro-duend reporting twenty-four Kav soldiers with lethal radiation trauma.
events.quote: Twenty-four KMN aboard with lethal radiation trauma.

events.summary: It is explained that Alpharael's Hopelight irradiated the Kav Memorial team when it crashed.
events.quote: When Alpharael's Hopelight came down, it irradiated the entire Kav Memorial team with its fusion engine.

events.summary: The dying Kav staggered into the Seriema's cargo bay and begged for rescue.
events.quote: They had just enough strength left to stagger into the Seriema 's cargo bay and beg for rescue.

events.summary: Sami denies to Taro-duend that the Seriema fired a fusion drive.
events.quote: It wasn't us.

events.summary: Recalling earlier events, Sami notes that Alpharael had a fit when put in the stasis cask with the stone.
events.quote: when Sami put the bleeding Monoist in the stasis cask with the rock, the Monoist had a fit.

events.summary: Sami discovers a perfect hole in Alpharael's right palm under the medical sleeve.
events.quote: they discovered a mystery: a perfect hole in his right palm.

events.summary: Tannuk argues that Alpharael's fusion burn was a disaster, not evil, and cannot be punished.
events.quote: You can't avenge a disaster. You can't punish a disaster.

events.summary: In a flashback, as lead daunt Tannuk commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide aimed at Summotank.
events.quote: He commanded the Guns of Kavaron to fire on a bolide headed for the city of Summotank, where four million Kav dwell on the drainage lake of great shattersprings.

events.summary: Tannuk braked the bolide so it fell on mountain villages, killing twenty-five thousand Kav, which the Kav see as murder by engineered misfortune.
events.quote: Tannuk killed twenty-five thousand Kav.

events.summary: Sami lands in a slag pool at Taro-duend and the pool is drained as Kav rescue crews rush the ship.
events.quote: The moment that Sami cuts thrust, someone opens the sluicegate and drains the slag pool.

events.summary: Ambulances take the comatose Kav away.
events.quote: The Trample ambulances take them away.

events.summary: Sami tells the coach a story of rescuing the soldiers while the coach repeats Sami's words, and offers engine telemetry as proof of innocence.
events.quote: I'm going to tell the truth.

events.summary: Tannuk passes as a stroke-addled man to the political postilion, claiming a mining accident at Sigma's Reach.
events.quote: Mining accident. No air. Had to breathe liquid.

events.summary: The postilion unwittingly reveals that Kav believe Sigma's Reach has miners and exports moxite.
events.quote: They'd want Kav labor, wouldn't they?

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk puzzle that the Sigma mine never opened yet moxite prices fell.
events.quote: That mine never opened.

events.summary: Tannuk volunteers to fetch fuel while Sami investigates Sigma's Reach.
events.quote: So, Tan goes out to buy fuel and reaction mass for the Seriema .

events.summary: Sami goes to ask the political postilion what he knows about Sigma's Reach.
events.quote: And Sami, mouse-small in the crowds of Kav, goes to find the political postilion and ask him what he knows about Sigma's Reach.

events.summary: The postilion asks Sami where their addled man Gorodoro is.
events.quote: Where is your addled man? Gorodoro?

events.summary: The postilion sees through Sami's act and asks if they are a liar.
events.quote: Are you a liar, Captain Sami?

events.summary: The postilion says he saw the hotcell cask stamped for Sigma's Reach.
events.quote: I saw the hotcell cask. It had a destination stamp, Sigma's Reach.

events.summary: The postilion reveals that cheap moxite from Sigma's Reach ruined his moxite futures.
events.quote: And instead it plummeted! Undercut by cheap, clean moxite from Sigma's Reach!

events.summary: Sami tells the postilion that Sigma's Reach never opened, shocking him.
events.quote: Sigma's Reach never opened.

events.summary: Sami asks about Mirri, showing a picture.
events.quote: Sami produces a picture of Mirri.

events.summary: A Sunstar Free Company ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.
events.quote: It's the Sunstar Free Company. They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

events.summary: The postilion refuses to hand over Sami and decides to obstruct justice.
events.quote: This is a harbor for scum!

relations.note: Sami trusts Tannuk with their life.
relations.quote: I trust him with my life

relations.note: Tannuk serves as Sami's first mate.
Tannuk was a KMN command pilot before his exile.
relations.quote: Tan was a Kavaron Memorial Navy command pilot.

relations.note: Taro-duend sits on Kavaron That Is.
relations.quote: Taro-duend is a burst of color on the basalt and glass of Kavaron That Is.

relations.note: The Free Company demands the escaped spies sheltering at Taro-duend.
relations.quote: They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.
